reasons: Non-successful responses are handled, but network failures are not handled separately.
Credentials are sent inside the web address.

terms.meaning: a doorway other programs use to ask a service for data
the ID and key that prove the app is allowed to use a service
the part of a web address after the question mark that carries the search settings

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: File header and free-tier note
sections.what: Names the service and its free monthly limit, and links to its documentation.
sections.why: Records the limit and the source so later readers can check the rules.

sections.name: AdzunaJob, AdzunaCountry
sections.title: Job listing and country types
sections.what: Defines the shape of one job listing used across the app, and the fixed list of country codes Adzuna accepts.
sections.why: Gives every job the same fields so other code can rely on them.
sections.watch_out: A new country must be added to this list before it can be searched.

sections.name: REGION_TO_ADZUNA_COUNTRIES
sections.title: Region to country mapping
sections.what: Translates the app's region choices into the Adzuna country codes to search. The Middle East maps only to the UAE, and global maps to three countries.
sections.why: The inline comment says the UAE is the only Middle East country Adzuna supports.
sections.watch_out: The global option covers only three countries, so it is not truly worldwide.

sections.name: adzunaSearch
sections.title: Running one Adzuna search
sections.what: Runs one search for a keyword, optional location and country, and returns the matching jobs in the app's shape.
sections.why: Keeps all the Adzuna web-call details in one place.
sections.watch_out: Each call counts against the monthly free limit, and the credentials travel in the web address.

summary: Searches the Adzuna job board and returns listings in one common shape the rest of the app uses.
purpose: Lets the app find job postings by keyword, optional location and country.
why: The file header states that the free tier allows 1,000 requests per month per app, so calls should be deliberate.
how: 1. Checks that the app ID and app key are present. 2. Builds the search address from the country, page number and filters. 3. Fetches it without caching. 4. Throws an error if the response is not successful. 5. Converts each result into the AdzunaJob shape, leaving missing fields empty.
inputs: App ID and app key, plus search options: country code, keyword, optional location, results per page, page number, sort order and maximum age of postings in days.
outputs: A list of AdzunaJob records. The list is empty if Adzuna returns no results.
risks: The app ID and key are placed in the web address, so they can appear in server or proxy logs. Each call uses one of the monthly free requests. Company, location and salary fields may be missing.
debug: If an error says credentials are missing, check the environment settings. A status code error includes the country and status, so a 401 or 403 points to the keys. An empty list usually means the keyword or country is too narrow.
